items.item: The page header has a plural title and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 "Equipment" (collective noun, matches nav label); header has #exportBtn (white, bordered, secondary) and #addBtn (bg-blue-700, the only primary); audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: The table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (such as location and status) and no row of KPI cards above it
items.evidence: Screenshot: table starts at y=270 of 900 (audit firstTableTop 270). Search #q plus selects #fLoc, #fStatus, #fType (3 filters). No KPI cards; only tabs and a one-line summary.

items.item: By default the list is ordered with overdue inspections first, then inspections due soon, then the rest
items.evidence: S.sort='attention'; sorted() orders by group() (0 overdue, 1 due within 14 days, 2 rest), then by next date. Screenshot shows Overdue 36 days down to Overdue 2 days, then Due in 1 day to Due in 5 days.

items.item: Overdue and due-soon inspections are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 7 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: inspLabel() returns 'Overdue N days' / 'Due today' / 'Due in N days', rendered as a text badge in the Next inspection cell.

items.item: Dates are absolute and consistently formatted, and every row has a human-readable equipment code
items.evidence: All dates go through Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', day 2-digit, month short, year numeric), e.g. '02 Aug 2026'. Every row has a code link such as FLT-803, CNC-204, PRS-102.

items.item: Status tabs or a summary line show counts (such as "Overdue 4")
items.evidence: Tabs 'All 30', 'Needs attention 14', 'Under maintenance 3', 'Out of service 2'. Summary line: '30 machines · 6 overdue · 8 due within 14 days'.

items.item: Rows are single-line, and row actions show at most two visible controls, with icon-only controls having accessible names
items.evidence: Audit rows single=10, double=0, all 40px tall. Row actions: 'Log service' button plus a '...' .menuBtn with aria-label='Actions for <id>'. Other actions sit in the menu.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading state and an error state with retry are present
items.evidence: No matches: 'No equipment matches these filters' with #clearAll2 'Clear filters'. First-use empty (?state=empty): 'No equipment yet' with 'Add equipment'. Loading: skeleton rows plus 'Loading equipment…'. Error (?state=error): 'Could not load equipment' with #retry button.

items.item: Interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: Audit smallTargets=0 and no contrast violations (132 text nodes checked). Buttons and selects are h-8 (32px). Status badges use 800-on-50 tints, and secondary text is slate-600 or darker. Row checkboxes are 16px but isolated in 40px rows, so the spacing exception applies.

notes: Clean, restrained screen. No KPI tiles, gradients (only a loading-skeleton shimmer, not a decorative gradient), emoji, avatars, promo cards, tracked uppercase labels or hover-lift. Radii are small (4 and 6px). Status colours are semantic and always paired with text. Minor points: the title 'Equipment' is uncountable rather than strictly plural, and the filter-chip close buttons are 20px (shown only while filters are active). Audit score 100, no violations.
